This approach avoids the need for bone and muscle incisions, reducing postoperative pain and accelerating recovery., and all possible outcomes in great detail, which gave my wife, me and our family a lot of confidence and reassurance. His guidance before the surgery, along with the pre- and post-operative preparations, was thorough.
Dr Mishra's approachability and warmth, calm, compassionate, willingness to address even the smallest concerns are the traits that truly sets Dr. Mishra apart in this super specialty profession. We are deeply grateful for his expertise, care, and dedication. I would highly recommend Dr. Prashant Mishra to anyone looking for an exceptional super specialty cardiac surgeon who combines medical excellence with genuine human concern.
